description: Answering a downstream/graph question before revising an ADR: the history skill must report the transitive closure of artefacts that derive from the queried ADR — following `Derives-From` trailer edges forward across both hops (ADR -> plan -> code) and taking each hop's node identity from the deriving commit's changed files — excluding a commit that names the ADR's path only in its subject line (no trailer) and excluding an artefact pair that merely shares a number with a real downstream node, and never listing the queried ADR itself as a downstream node.
